Name: Emo Emus for Mizus Emu
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]When using the [b]Mizu’s Emu[/b] mod, you can now get [b]EMO EMUS*[/b], which behave identically, but look cool (it's just a new skin).[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]Mizu[/url] for the base emu image, and the mod that this is built on.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]*Their canonical taste in music is a mix of My Chemical Romance, Fall Out Boy, Panic! at the Disco, Sleeping with Sirens and The Used.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Mine are named Bert, Quinn and Gerard, but name them what you wish.[/color]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Emo Emu
Manifest.Description: Adds an Emo Emu skin to the emu from Mizu's Emu
